name: team_findings
unavailable: The person allows one agent in this chat: there is no team. Do the work yourself.
description: Findings kept beyond your context: `write` adds one (a fact, a result, where something is) to yours; `read` shows yours, or with `of` those of a subagent under you (the main agent: anyone's), ended ones included. Write as you go: when your context fills you have one turn left, and your findings are what the next agent starts from.

of.description: read: a name or an id (default: yours)
